title: Candidate controller
summary: Release-run QA runs controller-side work (host control, mission preparation, walker mission commands) on the run's candidate Yoke build. After begin and before any host lease, an execution whose frozen target names an installer origin compares the controller's build commit with the candidate: the release_lineage the target's channel serves, or the release the deployed commit pins. A stale controller installs the candidate wheels into a private runtime under the Yoke machine home, never touching the installed CLI or its channel, and hands it the begun execution; walker commands name that runtime's executable. A runtime that cannot be provisioned refuses qa_controller_not_candidate with installed and candidate versions, aborts the unused execution and names the recovery. Machine and mission preparation evidence record controller_runtime with its source_commit.
